title: Support loading configuration from text files
author: pgjones
body:
TOML is a very popular format now, and is taking hold in the Python
ecosystem via pyproject.toml (among others). This allows toml config
files via,

    app.config.from_file("config.toml", toml.loads)

it also allows for any other file format whereby there is a loader
that takes a string and returns a mapping.

This is an alternative to #3386.

comments.author: davidism
comments.body: I'm not sure if it's worth pulling in TOML just for one test. Can this be tested with `json.load` instead?

comments.author: pgjones
comments.body: I've moved the toml example to the docs (from the tests).

review_comments.author: davidism
review_comments.body: Should this use `load(file_)`? If someone has a loader that doesn't support a file handle, they can wrap it as `lambda f: json.loads(f.read())`.

review_comments.author: davidism
review_comments.body: This should issue a `DeprecationWarning` to be removed in 2.0.

review_comments.author: davidism
review_comments.body: Make this an optional dependency with [`pytest.importorskip`](https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/skipping.html#skipping-on-a-missing-import-dependency) so users can run `pytest` directly for most contributions.

review_comments.author: pgjones
review_comments.body: I've removed it and added some docs instead.

 documentation.
 
 
+Configuring from Data Files
+---------------------------
+
+It is also possible to load configuration from a file in a format of
+your choice using :meth:`~flask.Config.from_file`. For example to load
+from a TOML file:
+
+.. code-block:: python
+
+    import toml
+    app.config.from_file("config.toml", load=toml.load)
+
+Or from a JSON file:
+
+.. code-block:: python
+
+    import json
+    app.config.from_file("config.json", load=json.load)
+
+
 Configuring from Environment Variables
 --------------------------------------
